interview.mode: adoption retrofit (ClaudeBase docs/ADOPTION.md -- in the plugin marketplace, not in this repo), derive-then-confirm

q1_name_and_goal.name: CardGenerator
q1_name_and_goal.goal: Generate print-ready boardgame card images at exact MakePlayingCards measurements from card data plus artwork.

q2_description_nongoals_users.description: Local tool for one custom dungeon-building boardgame. Card data plus artwork in, full-bleed PNG at MPC upload spec out. Eight card types share one HTML/CSS template family rendered through headless Chromium.
non_goals: not a game engine or rules simulator
not internet-facing - localhost, single user, no accounts
not a general-purpose card designer for other games
not an art tool - artwork is authored elsewhere

q4_toolchain_and_run.build: pip install -e . && python -m playwright install chromium

q5_verify.method: render one card of every type, assert every written PNG against its print profile, and cross-check the derivation against MPC's published figures
q5_verify.user_answer_verbatim: I would have the user only be able to input the card data and upload an image for it from which we generate the correct card image in the back with sub routine or similar. The uploaded user image does only need to be rectangular and maybe we will give a warning if its resolution is too low that is all for verifying it
q5_verify.note: The user's answer defines runtime validation of uploaded artwork (cardgen.spec.check_artwork, advisory warnings only). The command above is the development-time gate, which the answer did not cover; geometry correctness is additionally enforced as a pipeline invariant so it cannot be skipped.

interview.q10_git_mode: existing GitHub remote (Lutscherdieb/Dungeon_CardGenerator), work on branch v2

decisions_2026_08_24.card_formats: Everything stays square. Rules/Cardtypes.txt mentioning 'tcg format' for Overlord/Creature was an intention left open, not a spec.
decisions_2026_08_24.canvas_size: Fix to MPC's published 1122x1122 (was 1125x1125); safe zone 978 (was 975).
decisions_2026_08_24.web_stack: Keep CherryPy - switch to FastAPI only if performance demands it, which it does not; Playwright browser launches dominate render time, not the server.
decisions_2026_08_24.source_of_truth: SQL primary, with JSON import for the 137 existing cards.
decisions_2026_08_24.json_migration: Unify Rules/Description and flatten Slots. Keep Food - it is unused only because cards for it are not designed yet.

decisions_2026_08_29.slots_second_number: Means nothing. Author cleared the two Sacred Hain exceptions on 2026-08-29, leaving every spot 0; Room.Slots flattened to List[CreatureType].
decisions_2026_08_29.editor_placement: Inline full-width row inside the grid, below the selected card's row. Reverses the 2026-08-24 right-hand drawer, which narrowed the grid and made auto-fill reposition all 137 tiles on every open and close.
decisions_2026_08_29.filter_ui: Floating popover over the grid, controls derived from the union of the card schemas. Never displaces the gallery.
decisions_2026_08_29.starter_flag: Boolean on CardBase, so all eight types carry it. Prints as a CSS text stamp, not an asset.
decisions_2026_08_29.balance: Fit stat weights from the deck itself; author rulings correct the fit. Deterministic maths in src/cardgen/balance, judgment and memory in the /card-balance skill.
decisions_2026_08_29.frontend_structure: web/ split into ES modules, acyclic by construction. No build step.

divergences.what: Repository predates ClaudeBase. Its git history and content tree (data/, backgrounds/, Rules/, templates/, assets/, schemas/) were not laid out by the seed, and README.md carries the project's own sections around the seeded footer region.
divergences.why: Adopted via ClaudeBase's docs/ADOPTION.md rather than /base:new-project. The seed prescribes no source layout, so this is context for later sessions rather than a sync exception.

divergences.what: mpc-print-spec is a live website with no local path, so protect-references has nothing to block for it. Only game-rules (committed_path: Rules) is actually guarded.
divergences.why: The reference is genuinely remote. Recorded so /base:doctor reporting the guard as partly dormant reads as expected, not as breakage.

notes.verify_scope: web/** is mapped to a doc but deliberately left out of source_globs: the verify gate renders cards and says nothing about the gallery frontend, which tests/check_gallery.py covers against a running server. serve.bat / stop-server.bat / .vscode/tasks.json are launchers, likewise out of source_globs and into README's doc_map.
notes.settings_shape: `.claude/settings.json` sets `enabledPlugins` as an OBJECT map ({"base@claudebase": true}), not a list. It was written as a list and Claude Code reported the settings file as failing to parse even though the JSON was syntactically valid -- the mismatch is schema, not syntax. When a settings file is rejected, diff its shape key-by-key against a file the host already accepts (~/.claude/settings.json here) before hunting for a bad comma.
